title: M5.4: SMS adapter inbound and outbound
description:
Normalize inbound SMS (pair granularity to the member's direct channel), verify the SNS signature and topic, render replies segment-aware (GSM-7 versus UCS-2 counting, cap 3 segments, short link to the full answer in the web app), deliver through the send API with delivery receipts mapped to status events.

Acceptance criteria:
- A linked member's text starts a turn and receives a capped reply
- Long answers produce a link, not ten segments
- Delivery receipt updates the delivery item

Gherkin: features/sms_conversations.feature

Depends on: M5.3, M2.1

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
